<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/site.ts -->
<!--
  The page header: a skip link to the main content, the brand, the two navigation links (the current one carries
  aria-current) and the theme button. `current` is the route area. Axes: layout (inline, stacked), position
  (static, sticky), actions (none, cta).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { SiteHeaderLabels } from "./site-header.types";

export type SiteHeaderProps = {
  labels: SiteHeaderLabels;
  current: string;
  layout?: "inline" | "stacked";
  position?: "static" | "sticky";
  actions?: "none" | "cta";
  cta?: string;
  ctaHref?: string;
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Container from "../primitives/container/container.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import LinkPlain from "../primitives/link-plain/link-plain.vue";
import NavBlock from "../components/nav-block.vue";
import { cn, tpl, uniqLabel } from "../utils";

const {
  labels,
  current,
  layout = "inline",
  position = "static",
  actions = "none",
  cta,
  ctaHref,
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<SiteHeaderProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ theme: [] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="header"
    :class="cn(
      'border-b border-border bg-background',
      (((position as string) === 'sticky') ? 'sticky top-0 z-40' : '')
    )"
    data-testid="site-header"
    :data-layout="layout"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <LinkPlain
      href="#main-content"
      :class="'sr-only focus:not-sr-only focus:fixed focus:left-2 focus:top-2 focus:z-50 focus:rounded focus:bg-background ' +
        'focus:px-4 focus:py-2 focus:text-sm focus:inset-ring focus:inset-ring-border'"
      data-testid="skip-link"
    >
      {{ labels.skip }}
    </LinkPlain>
    <Container
      :class="cn(
        'mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4',
        'flex flex-wrap gap-4 py-4',
        (((layout as string) === 'stacked') ? 'flex-col items-center' : 'items-center justify-between')
      )"
      data-slot="container"
    >
      <Link href="#/" variant="default" class="text-lg font-medium" data-testid="brand">
        {{ labels.brand }}
      </Link>
      <NavBlock
        :label="(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl('{0}, {1}', labels.nav, landmarkLabel)) : labels.nav)"
        testid="site-nav"
      >
        <Group gap="4" align="center">
          <Link
            href="#/"
            variant="default"
            :aria-current="(((current as string) === 'home') ? 'page' : undefined)"
            data-testid="nav-link"
          >
            {{ labels.home }}
          </Link>
          <Link
            href="#/pricing"
            variant="default"
            :aria-current="(((current as string) === 'pricing') ? 'page' : undefined)"
            data-testid="nav-link"
          >
            {{ labels.pricing }}
          </Link>
        </Group>
      </NavBlock>
      <Group gap="4" align="center">
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" data-testid="theme-toggle" @click="() => emit('theme')">
          {{ labels.theme }}
        </Button>
        <Button
          v-if="(((actions as string) === 'cta') && cta)"
          variant="default"
          size="sm"
          :href="ctaHref"
          data-testid="header-cta"
        >
          {{ cta }}
        </Button>
      </Group>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
